REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JULY 2, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission
5.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
6.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Commissioner or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
6A.
Approval of Minutes

Regular Minutes of June 4, 2025

Reports from Designated Commission Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
8B.
Reports from Planning Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
July 2, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703
PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Vice Chair Deepak "DJ" Jhaveri
  Chair Jose "Armin" Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Current Planning Manager Amanda AcuHa
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Metr6 Anthony
1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledgeof Allegiance was led by Commissioner Chauhan.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.
4.  Annual Reorganization of the Planning Commission
  Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan declared the position of Chair of the
  Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Surti nominated Vice Chair Reyes for Chair. Commissioner
  Chauhanseconded the nomination.

  CommissionerAo nominated Commissioner Jhaveri for Chair. Seeing no second
  to the motion for nomination, CommissionerAo’s nominationfailed.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.

  MOTION: Commissioner Surti nominated Vice Chair Reyes for Chair. Commissioner
  Chauhan seconded the nomination.

City of Cerritos  July 2, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   The motion carried (4-0-1) as follows:
  AYES:  Chauhan, Jhaveri, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN :  Ao

  Vice Chair Reyes was declared Chair of the Planning Commission.

  Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan declared the position of Vice Chair of
  the Planning Commission vacant and called for nominations.

  Commissioner Chauhan nominated Commissioner Jhaveri for Vice Chair.
  Commissioner Ao seconded the nomination.

  Chair Reyes nominated Commissioner Surti for Vice Chair. Seeing no second to
  the motion for nomination, Chair Reyes’ nomination failed.

  There were no other nominations, and nominations were closed.
  MOTION: Commissioner Chauhan nominated Commissioner Jhaveri for Vice
  Chair. Commissioner Ao seconded the nomination.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:
  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Commissioner Jhaveri was declared Vice Chair of the Planning Commission.

  To allow the Chair and Vice Chair to take their new seats at the dias, a meeting
  recess was called by Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Chair Reyes closed public comments.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, June 4, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  Commissioner Chauhan requested a modification to the minutes under Section 7C to
  include a statement noting that there are substantial costs associated with the
  required environmental analysis pursuant to CEQArequirements. The Planning
  Commission acknowledged the request, and the amendment was incorporated into
  the record accordingly.

  MOTION: it was moved by Commissioner Ao, and seconded by Vice Chair Jhaveri,
  to approve the Wednesday, June 4, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular
  Meeting Minutes.
City of Cerritos  July 2, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page2
   The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Public Hearings
7A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTIONOF
  THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-6. A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  AND SECOND-FLOOR ADDITION TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AT
  19525  SHERYL  AVENUE.  CERRITOS.  CALIFORNIA.  90703.  THE  SUBJECT
  PROPERTYIS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7050-015-
  028).#

  +Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Metr6 Anthony. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and
  existing property conditions that do not comply with Cerritos Municipal Code
  requirements. Mr. Anthony provided details about the removal of an unpermitted
  addition, constructionof a 574-square-footfirst-floor addition, and a new 686-
  square-foot second floor. Discussion followed regarding the design of the new first-
  floor addition, second floor and the proposed floor plan. Mr. Anthony concluded his
  presentation by stating that no public comments were received regarding the
  proposed project.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes
  declared the public hearing closed.

  MOTION: it was moved by Commissioner Surti and seconded by Commissioner
  Jhaveri to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-10:
  RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2025-6,
  A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTYOWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  AND SECOND-FLOOR ADDITION TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AT
  19525 SHERYL AVENUE. CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA. 90703. THE SUBJECT
  PROPERTYIS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7050-015-
  028)

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:
  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT;  None
  ABSTAIN :  None

7B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTIONOF
  THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDINGAPPROVALOF PRECISE
  PLAN 1972-29(A)(2025) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY THE PROPERTY OWNERS
  LH INVESTMENT GROUP LLC, TO CONSTRUCT AN ADDITION TO AN EXISTING
  WAREHOUSE BUILDING AND COMPLETEOTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS

   AT 14113  183RD STRRET. CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.  90703.  THE SUBJECT

  (APN 7022-014-019).8

  +Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPointpresentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed 9,994-square foot addition
  project and existing property conditions. Mr. Loh provided details about the proposed

  Discussion followed regarding the design and location of proposed facility
  improvementsto the eastern portion of the subject property. Mr. Loh concludedhis

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes

  ADDITION  TO AN EXISTING  WAREHOUSE  BUILDING  AND  COMPLETE OTHER
  RELATED  SITE  IMPROVEMENTS  AT  14113  183RD  STRRET.  CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA. 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED INDUSTRIAL
  (M)/EMERGENCY SHELTEROVERLAY(M-1) (APN 7022-014-019).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes

8.  Reports
8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan congratulated Chair Reyes and Vice Chair
  Jhaveri on their new roles on the Planning Commission. Mrs. Chan concluded by
  informing the Commission that the next Planning Commission meeting will be held
  on Wednesday, August 6, 2025.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members
  Reports were given by Commissioner Ao, Commissioner Chauhan, Commissioner
  Surti, Vice Chair Jhaveri, and Chair Reyes.
9.  Adjournment
  The meeting adjourned at 7:55 p.m.
